description: Get one SMS delivery result (GET /sms/v2/services/{serviceId}/messages/{messageId}): status READY|PROCESSING|COMPLETED, statusCode (carrier result code), statusName success|fail, telcoCode, completeTime.

messageId.description: Message ID (from the send response or ncloud_sens_list_sms_requests)

serviceId.description: SMS service ID in NRN form (e.g. ncp:sms:kr:1********2:myproject). Defaults to NCLOUD_SENS_SMS_SERVICE_ID / NCLOUD_SENS_SERVICE_ID. Find it with ncloud_sens_list_projects (smsService.serviceId). A 'Forbidden' reply means the project does not have this channel enabled.

name: ncloud_sens_get_sms_status
